Inception.description: A skilled thief who infiltrates dreams to steal secrets is offered a chance to return to his former life by completing an almost impossible job: planting an idea in someone’s subconscious. To succeed, he assembles a team and navigates increasingly complex layers of dreams.

Interstellar.description: As Earth becomes increasingly difficult to inhabit, a former pilot joins a team of explorers searching for a new home for humanity. Their mission takes them through a newly discovered wormhole and across vast distances, while the journey tests their courage, relationships, and understanding of time.

Dune.description: A gifted young heir and his family are sent to Arrakis, a dangerous desert world that holds the empire’s most valuable resource. As rival forces compete for control, he must confront growing danger, political intrigue, and visions of a destiny he does not yet understand.

Arrival.description: After alien crafts appear around the world, a skilled linguist joins a military-led effort to communicate with their mysterious occupants. As international tensions rise, she must work carefully to understand their language and intentions before fear turns the encounter into a global crisis.

Tron Legacy.description: A daring young heir investigates his father’s disappearance and is drawn into a sleek digital world. With help from a mysterious program, he must navigate dangerous challenges and confront a powerful ruler determined to break into the real world.

Tron Ares.description: A highly advanced program is sent from a digital world into modern reality on a dangerous mission. As this first encounter between humanity and artificial beings unfolds, corporate interests and questions about artificial intelligence raise the stakes.

Wall-E.description: On a deserted Earth buried in waste, a lonely cleanup robot discovers a new purpose after meeting an advanced probe sent to search for signs of life. Their connection leads them from the planet to a spacebound human community and an unexpected adventure tied to humanity’s future.

Top Gun Maverick.description: After decades as a celebrated Navy pilot, a veteran instructor is called back to train a new group of elite aviators for an exceptionally dangerous mission. As the team prepares, he must confront his past while earning the trust of pilots whose lives depend on his guidance.

Top Gun.description: A talented fighter pilot and his trusted co-pilot earn places at an elite training school, where intense competition, friendship, romance, and personal struggles test their ambitions. As pressure mounts, the pilot must confront painful consequences and decide whether he can regain his confidence and continue pursuing excellence.

Ratatouille.description: A talented rat dreams of becoming a chef and finds himself beneath a famous Paris restaurant. There, he forms an unlikely partnership with a young kitchen worker, secretly guiding his cooking while facing suspicion from the restaurant’s staff and resistance from his own colony.

Up.description: A widowed older man fulfills a lifelong dream by lifting his home with balloons and traveling toward a distant South American destination. A young wilderness scout accidentally joins him, and together they encounter unusual wildlife, talking dogs, and unexpected challenges along the way.

Wargames.description: A teenage computer enthusiast accidentally accesses a military war system while searching for unreleased games. When the system treats his playful simulation as a real threat, he and a friend must convince skeptical officials and find a way to prevent a global nuclear crisis.

The Men in Black.description: Psychiatrist, Conrad O'Brien (played by Doug Wertz), faces his own struggles. Recently divorced and the feeling of losing balance and trust of his own patients, he starts to self medicate to overcome. But then he believes he saw something that changes to course of everything. Is it real or is his life too overwhelming?

Back to the Future.description: An eighties teenager is accidentally sent back to 1955, where he disrupts his parents’ first meeting and risks changing his own future. With help from an eccentric inventor, he must restore the timeline, bring his parents together, and find a way home.

Toy Story 2.description: When a beloved cowboy toy is taken by a collector, his friends launch a daring rescue mission. Meanwhile, he meets new toys who challenge his ideas about friendship, purpose, and what it means to be loved as children grow up.

Armageddon.description: When a massive asteroid threatens Earth, NASA turns to a veteran driller and his unconventional crew for an unprecedented space mission. They must learn to work as astronauts, reach the asteroid, and place a nuclear device inside it before time runs out, while personal tensions add emotional stakes.

Finch.description: On a devastated Earth, a solitary survivor struggles to protect his beloved dog while his health declines. He builds a robot to care for the animal, then sets out with them across a dangerous landscape, where their journey explores companionship, trust, love, and what it means to be human.

2001: A Space Odyssey.description: A mysterious object discovered beneath the Moon’s surface leads humanity toward a mission to uncover its origins. Far from Earth, astronauts travel aboard a spacecraft guided by an advanced computer, as questions about intelligence, technology, and human progress grow increasingly unsettling.

The Santa Clause 2.description: A longtime Christmas gift-giver discovers that a hidden contract requirement could end his magical career unless he finds a wife before Christmas. While he returns to the human world to reconnect with his troubled teenage son and meet a potential partner, an artificial replacement causes chaos at the North Pole.

The Santa Clause.description: On Christmas Eve, a divorced dad and his son encounter Santa Claus after he’s fallen from their roof. As the magical sleigh and North Pole draw them in, the dad learns he’s now responsible for delivering presents and must earn belief from a skeptical world.

The Santa Clause 3.description: A busy holiday figure faces trouble when a jealous rival schemes to take over the North Pole and transform Christmas. As family pressures mount and the toy factory is threatened, he is tempted to give up his magical role and must fight to restore the holiday spirit.

Toy Story.description: A beloved cowboy toy faces an unexpected challenge when a flashy space-themed newcomer becomes the favorite in a child’s room. After rivalry separates them from their owner, the two must work together through a lively adventure, learning about friendship, loyalty, and accepting change.

The Chronicles of Narnia.description: Four siblings discover a magical wardrobe leading to Narnia, a once-peaceful kingdom trapped in eternal winter. With help from a wise lion and a host of fantastical creatures, they become caught in a struggle against the ruthless ruler responsible for the land’s icy oppression.

Swiss Family Robinson.description: After a shipwreck, a family is stranded on a tropical island filled with wildlife. They build a new home and adapt to island life, but their peaceful existence is threatened when pirates arrive, forcing them to rely on ingenuity, courage, and teamwork.

Finding Nemo.description: A curious young fish is taken from his ocean home to an aquarium, prompting his anxious father to cross the sea in search of him. Along the way, the father teams up with a friendly, forgetful fish and faces sharks, jellyfish, turtles, seabirds, and other unexpected challenges.

Finding Dory.description: When fragments of childhood memories begin returning, a forgetful fish sets out to find her parents, with help from her loyal friends. The journey leads through a marine life center filled with new companions, difficult obstacles, and reminders that determination and support can make a difference.

Escape to Witch Mountain.description: Two orphaned siblings with extraordinary powers are targeted by a wealthy man who wants to exploit their abilities. After escaping his control, they take refuge with a lonely widower and travel toward a mysterious mountain they believe may reveal where they truly belong.

The Parent Trap.description: Separated after their parents’ divorce, identical twin girls unexpectedly meet at summer camp and discover they are sisters. They secretly switch places to spend time with the parent they have never known and try to bring their divided family back together.

20,000 Leagues Under the Sea.description: A ship investigating mysterious sinkings encounters an advanced submarine and its isolated commander. A professor, his assistant, and a harpooner are taken aboard, where they explore an extraordinary underwater world while struggling with captivity, danger, and the commander’s determined opposition to civilization and warfare.

The Absent-Minded Professor.description: An absent-minded professor accidentally invents Flubber, a remarkable rubbery substance that gains energy when it bounces. He uses it to create astonishing jumps and make a Model-T fly, but a greedy businessman seeks to control the discovery for personal gain, putting the professor’s work and relationships under pressure.

Cars 2.description: A champion race car travels overseas with his best friend for the World Grand Prix. When the friend becomes entangled in an international espionage adventure, their trip turns into a fast-paced mix of racing, gadgets, danger, and unexpected teamwork.

Monsters, Inc..description: In a monster city powered by children's screams, a top scarer and his wisecracking partner face chaos when a little girl enters their world. As they try to keep her hidden and return her home, their assumptions about children—and their own workplace—are challenged.

Mary Poppins.description: In Edwardian London, a magical nanny arrives to care for two children whose busy parents have little time for them. Through playful adventures, music, and imagination, she helps the family rediscover the importance of connection, kindness, and enjoying childhood.

The Love Bug.description: A struggling race car driver discovers a battered little car with a mind of its own and teams up with a mechanic and a dealership assistant. As the car brings new success on the track, a dishonest rival tries to reclaim it, leading to comic rivalries, racing antics, and unexpected friendship.

Aladdin.description: A kindhearted street urchin discovers a magical lamp containing a wisecracking genie, setting him on an adventure filled with wishes, romance, music, and danger. Meanwhile, a power-hungry royal adviser seeks the lamp’s magic for his own ambitions.

ARGYLE.description: When aspiring filmmaker Charlie receives a one-time offer from a controversial, once-prominent documentary filmmaker, he reluctantly agrees to return to the small town where he was raised to investigate the origins of a notorious serial killer who also grew up there. Once home, he must contend with agitated townsfolk, pressure from his crew, and the awkwardness of reconnecting with the townies who never left.

The Lion King.description: A young lion grows up admiring his father and embracing his future as ruler, while his uncle secretly schemes for power. After betrayal and tragedy force him into exile, the lion finds guidance from unexpected friends and must learn to face his past and reclaim his place.

Pollyanna.description: An optimistic orphan arrives in a gloomy New England town to live with her wealthy aunt. Through her cheerful outlook and curiosity, she challenges the adults around her and gradually brings warmth, connection, and renewed hope to the community.

Alice in Wonderland.description: A 19-year-old woman follows a white rabbit and returns to a strange fantasy world from her childhood. As the land struggles under a cruel ruler, she joins its unusual inhabitants on a dangerous quest while confronting expectations about her future and discovering her own sense of purpose.

The Great Mouse Detective.description: When a London toymaker is kidnapped, his young daughter seeks help from a brilliant mouse detective and his dependable companion. Their investigation leads through Victorian London's hidden corners as they follow clues, confront a dangerous criminal mastermind, and race to stop an ambitious scheme.

The Secret Garden.description: After losing her parents in India, a young British girl is sent to live with her distant uncle in a gloomy English castle. Exploring the estate, she discovers a locked, forgotten garden and begins restoring it with help from a servant’s boy, uncovering long-buried secrets along the way.

A Bug’s Life.description: An inventive ant accidentally disrupts his colony’s food offering to a group of demanding grasshoppers. Hoping to protect everyone and make amends, he sets out to recruit supposed warrior bugs, bringing an unexpected group of performers back to help defend the colony.

Tarzan.description: An orphaned human boy is raised by a family of apes in the jungle, believing he belongs among them. When an expedition introduces him to people like himself, he must confront his identity and decide where he truly belongs while navigating friendship, romance, and danger.

National Treasure.description: A modern treasure hunter and his team pursue a legendary fortune hidden during the Revolutionary War. Their search leads to secret clues connected to historic American documents, while they race against a ruthless rival determined to claim the treasure first.

Frozen.description: A young princess sets out to end an eternal winter that has overtaken her kingdom. Joined by an ice seller, a reindeer, and a cheerful snowman, she faces a dangerous journey while discovering the meaning of family, friendship, courage, and true love.

The Little Mermaid.description: A curious young mermaid dreams of exploring the human world and falls for a prince after rescuing him from danger. Defying her father’s rules, she makes a risky bargain with a sea witch for the chance to live on land, putting her future and family in jeopardy.

Annie.description: A spirited orphan living under harsh conditions gets the chance to stay in a wealthy businessman’s mansion. As she adjusts to her new surroundings and hopes to find her parents, a promised reward attracts people willing to deceive the family.

Cars 3.description: A legendary racer struggles to keep up with a new generation of faster competitors and faces an uncertain future in the sport he loves. With help from an ambitious young technician and guidance inspired by an old mentor, he trains for one more chance to prove himself.

An American Tail.description: A young mouse travels with his family from Russia to America, hoping for a safer life. Separated during the journey, he arrives alone in New York and must navigate unfamiliar streets, dangerous cats, loneliness, and the determination to find his way home.

Toy Story 3.description: As their longtime owner prepares to leave for college, a beloved group of toys faces an uncertain future after being mistakenly sent to a daycare center. What first seems like a fresh start becomes a dangerous situation, forcing them to work together on an escape and confront the challenge of moving on.

Mulan.description: When a decree calls one man from every family to serve in the army, a spirited young woman disguises herself as a man and takes her ailing father’s place. Tested by military training, family expectations, and invading forces, she must draw on her courage and hidden strength to protect those she loves.

Pocahontas.description: A young woman, daughter of a tribal chief, falls in love with an English soldier as colonists arrive in Virginia. With tensions rising between the newcomers and her people, she seeks understanding and peace while confronting conflicting loyalties.

The Jungle Book.description: A boy raised by wolves must leave the jungle when a dangerous tiger threatens his safety. Guided by a watchful panther and a carefree bear, he travels through a perilous wilderness while searching for where he truly belongs.

Inside Out.description: When an 11-year-old moves to a new city, five personified emotions try to guide her through the upheaval. After Joy and Sadness become separated from the control center, they travel through the mind’s strange, colorful landscapes to return and help restore balance.

Beauty and the Beast.description: A young woman takes her father’s place as a prisoner in an enchanted castle ruled by a cursed prince. As she gets to know him and the castle’s magical inhabitants, an unlikely connection begins to grow while danger threatens their chance at freedom.

Cinderella.description: After losing her father, a kind young woman is forced to serve her cruel stepmother and stepsisters. Her life begins to change when she meets a charming stranger and receives unexpected help that gives her a chance to attend a royal ball.

Lady and the Tramp.description: A pampered dog loses her comfortable place at home after a baby arrives and ends up on the streets. A streetwise stray rescues her from danger and introduces her to a freer way of life, bringing two very different dogs together on an unexpected adventure.

One Hundred and One Dalmatians.description: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies is abducted by a wealthy woman seeking a fur coat, their devoted parents set out to rescue them. With help from a far-reaching network of dogs, the family faces a dangerous escape through the city and snowy countryside.

The Aristocats.description: When a wealthy Parisian woman leaves her fortune to her beloved cats, her greedy butler plots to remove them from the inheritance. Stranded in the countryside, a mother cat and her kittens meet a streetwise alley cat who helps them find their way home.

The Emperor’s New Groove.description: A self-absorbed emperor is accidentally transformed into a llama and must depend on a humble villager to survive the jungle. Together, they face comic obstacles as the emperor tries to return home and reclaim his throne.

Chicken Little.description: After being ridiculed for warning that the sky is falling, a young chicken tries to rebuild his reputation with help from a small group of outcast friends. When strange events threaten their town, they work together to uncover the truth and protect their community.

Meet the Robinsons.description: A brilliant young inventor living in an orphanage builds a machine to help find his mother. At a science fair, he meets a mysterious boy from the future and is swept into an eccentric family’s strange, colorful world.

Peter Pan.description: In early 20th-century London, a young girl and her brothers are swept away from their nursery by a boy who refuses to grow up. Together, they journey to Neverland, a magical realm of fairies, pirates, jungles, and thrilling adventures that challenge their ideas about childhood and growing older.

Sleeping Beauty.description: A princess cursed in infancy is hidden away under the care of three good fairies. As her sixteenth birthday approaches, the evil fairy who cast the curse searches for her, threatening to make the prophecy come true.

The Princess and the Frog.description: A hardworking waitress dreams of opening her own restaurant, but her plans change after she encounters a frog claiming to be a prince. A kiss transforms them both, sending the unlikely pair on a lively journey through New Orleans and the bayou to find a way back.

Bambi.description: A young deer grows up in the forest, discovering friendship, seasonal changes, love, and the challenges of life in the wild. Told through gentle, episodic moments, the story follows his journey from childhood toward adulthood amid both beauty and danger.

Dumbo.description: A young elephant with oversized ears discovers he can fly, transforming a struggling traveling circus into a sensation. As the circus pursues a glittering new opportunity, a family and their friends uncover troubling truths behind the spectacle and fight to protect the animals they love.

The Lost Bus.description: When a fast-moving wildfire traps a teacher and her students, a reluctant school bus driver volunteers to bring them to safety. As smoke, flames, blocked roads, and widespread chaos close in, the group must rely on courage and cooperation during a desperate journey through the disaster.

Wall E.description: On a deserted Earth buried in waste, a lonely cleanup robot discovers a new purpose after meeting an advanced probe sent to search for signs of life. Their connection leads them from the planet to a spacebound human community and an unexpected adventure tied to humanity’s future.

Men in Black.description: After encountering an alien during a police chase, a New York City cop is recruited into a secret agency that monitors extraterrestrial activity on Earth. Paired with a veteran agent, he must help stop an intergalactic threat while learning to navigate a hidden world of aliens, unusual technology, and erased memories.

Tron.description: A brilliant video game creator is pulled into a digital world after hacking his former employer’s mainframe. Forced to compete in dangerous games, he joins a security program and other allies in a fight against a powerful controlling force.

Cars.description: A hotshot rookie race car is unexpectedly detoured into a sleepy Route 66 town while heading to a major championship. As he gets to know the town’s colorful residents, he begins to discover that friendship, teamwork, and the journey itself may matter more than winning.

ARGYLLE.description: A reclusive author of espionage novels finds her fictional plots echoing the covert actions of a real spy organization. With her cat and a spy at her side, she is pulled into a globe-spanning chase where the boundary between imagination and reality begins to blur.

Planes.description: A crop-dusting plane dreams of entering a famous international air race, despite being afraid of heights. With guidance from a retired pilot and encouragement from loyal friends, the determined underdog prepares to challenge experienced competitors and pursue an unlikely dream.
